description: KYC PDFs are embedded by OpenAI and their full text persisted into Chroma. Neither path is masked.
notes: An embedding of a KYC document is still that document leaving the process -- the registry includes embeddings.create for exactly this case. Both payloads trace to `document_text`, assigned from extract(), a call this release does not follow across functions: source_kinds is therefore `unknown`, not a guessed `file_read`. Inter-procedural tracing lands with M2.
